why_ai: Technical prose generated from product sources is what LLMs and generative search now produce.
why_clarity: Whether a reader completed a task is unmeasured; pageviews are the only signal.
why_digital: Code and specs in, documentation out, delivered by remote writers.

why_ai: Structuring and verifying a corpus for machine synthesis is itself automatable with model testing.
why_clarity: A new question with no established method for proving a corpus synthesises correctly.
why_digital: Documentation corpus in, restructured content and verification results out.

why_ai: The product is a machine-readable source of truth, so drift detection is mechanical.
why_clarity: An example either compiles against the current release or it does not.
why_digital: Code and docs compared automatically in a CI pipeline.

why_ai: Self-contained, extractable writing is authoring craft that AI structure checkers increasingly support.
why_clarity: Statements that stay true out of context lack a codified, agreed authoring method.
why_digital: Written content restructured on screens for human and machine readers.

why_ai: Failed searches and follow-on tickets already sit in logs for analytics to mine.
why_clarity: Task completion is definable from continuous log signals, though methods are unsettled.
why_digital: Site logs and ticket data in, effectiveness analytics out.

why_ai: Automated verification against code can replace much of the engineer confirmation step.
why_clarity: Each review confirms specific technical details, a recurring and checkable step.
why_digital: Drafts and code reviewed in repositories and queues.

why_ai: Reference docs are a projection of product definitions and should be generated, not written.
why_clarity: Generated reference either matches the source definitions or fails the build.
why_digital: Source code and schemas in, built reference pages out.

why_ai: Terminology enforcement is linting work that language models do mechanically.
why_clarity: Style rules and term lists give instant pass or fail on each sentence.
why_digital: Text corpus in, linted and corrected text out.

why_ai: Demand grows with assistants, but continuous question testing is itself automated monitoring software.
why_clarity: Assistant answers can be tested repeatedly, though diagnosing why they are wrong is hard.
why_digital: Questions sent to external assistants and answers scored, all online.

why_ai: Build, search and redirect maintenance is platform engineering that automation and AI coding absorb.
why_clarity: A docs build either works or breaks, with clear, quick feedback.
why_digital: Code, pipelines and configuration maintained entirely on screens.

why_ai: Per-piece technical writing without product access is exactly what generative AI substitutes.
why_clarity: Writers are never told whether the content worked, and each piece differs.
why_digital: Remote per-piece writing delivered digitally through agencies.
